content.title: Wipro Targets Rising Cyber Threats With New CrowdStrike Backed Service
content.summary: Wipro Limited (NYSE:WIT) has expanded its collaboration with CrowdStrike Holdings (NASDAQ:CRWD) to introduce Wipro CyberShieldSM MDR, a managed security service designed to streamline enterprise security operations through artificial intelligence and automation. The new service, unveiled on Monday, integrates CrowdStrike’s Falcon® Next-Gen SIEM with Wipro’s global cybersecurity capabilities.
